rows.label: Admission: one B-or-better department course, plus a chat with the director of undergraduate studies
rows.note: Needs a department course (not a first-year writing seminar or a lab) earned with a B or higher. That course also counts toward the major.

rows.label: Every course used for the major needs a letter grade of B- or better (S/U only if no letter option exists)
One global course: theatre, cinema/media, or dance
Six rubric courses: a three-course sequence in one rubric plus one course in each other rubric
rows.note: Counts PMA-coded courses from the page rubric lists. A course cross-listed under another subject counts in a rubric slot only if the student says PMA faculty teach it (a question appears when it would help); otherwise it counts only as the elective. Confirm the sequence includes a 3000-to-4000 progression.

rows.label: Sequence in history/theory/criticism, one course in each other rubric
Sequence in creative authorship, one course in each other rubric
Sequence in design, one course in each other rubric
Sequence in embodied performance, one course in each other rubric
Check your sequence includes a progression from a 3000-level to a 4000-level course, plus a third course adding depth
A cross-listed course taught by PMA faculty may count toward a rubric slot, with your advisor's confirmation; other cross-listings count only as the elective
rows.note: Answer the question on the board for each cross-listed course on a rubric list. The board cannot see who teaches a course, so without a yes it keeps the course out of the rubric slots.

rows.label: One production lab (media production or production technology)
One elective of 3 or more credits (any undergraduate PMA course or cross-listing, not a production lab)
rows.note: Any undergraduate PMA-coded or cross-listed course of 3+ credits, except production labs and first-year writing seminars. Cross-listings taught outside PMA can only fill this slot. Check unusual courses with the DUS.

rows.label: Elective: confirm with your advisor if your course is unusual (an independent study, a seminar form, a course taught by another department)
rows.note: The elective is any 3+ credit PMA course or cross-listing other than a production lab, so most courses count on their own. Variable-credit courses must be taken for 3 or more credits.

questions.quote: Cross listed courses not taught by PMA faculty can only fulfill the elective requirement in the PMA Major.
